title: API Endpoints Overview
summary: This module defines all public API endpoints for the application, providing interfaces for chat interactions, D&D playground features, SAE analysis, and core system functionalities like health checks and metadata.

nodes.label: Chat Interface Endpoints
nodes.title: Chat Interface Endpoints
nodes.description: Provides API endpoints for various chat functionalities, including streaming, persona steering, and different chat modes.

nodes.label: D&D Playground Endpoints
nodes.title: D&D Playground Endpoints
nodes.description: Offers API endpoints specifically for the Dungeons & Dragons playground functionality, allowing interaction with its features.

nodes.label: SAE Endpoints
nodes.title: SAE Endpoints
nodes.description: Exposes API endpoints for interacting with Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) functionalities, such as comparing and snapshotting SAE states.

nodes.label: System Endpoints
nodes.title: System Endpoints
nodes.description: Provides core API endpoints for application lifecycle management, health checks, and metadata retrieval for the chat interface.

nodes.label: Persona Steering & Generation
nodes.title: Persona Steering & Generation
nodes.description: Manages the core logic for applying persona steering vectors to language models and generating steered responses.

nodes.label: SAE Experimentation & Analysis
nodes.title: SAE Experimentation & Analysis
nodes.description: Orchestrates a full suite of experiments for Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs), including data generation, encoding, attribution, and analysis.

groups.label: User-Facing APIs
groups.title: User-Facing API Endpoints
groups.description: These modules expose the primary functionalities of the application to external users and clients, covering chat, D&D playground, and SAE interactions.

groups.label: Core System APIs
groups.title: Core System API Endpoints
groups.description: This module provides essential endpoints for application health, lifecycle management, and metadata retrieval, supporting the overall system operation.

groups.label: Underlying Logic Modules
groups.title: Underlying Logic Modules
groups.description: These modules encapsulate the complex business logic and AI functionalities that power the user-facing API endpoints, including persona steering and SAE experimentation.
